A1-REP: Type_Manif(#codeType, libType) ; Manifestation(#codeManif, nomManif, dateOuv, dateFer, codeType#) ; Halle(#codeHalle, libHalle, nbStandsMax) ; Stand(#codeStand, designation, superficie, etat, codeHalle#) ; Client(#codeCl, nomCl, telCl, emailCl, pays) ; Location(#codeManif#, #codeStand#, dateLoc, prix, codeCl#) ; Evaluation(#codeEval, dateEval, noteAccueil, noteConfort, noteSignal, noteLogistique, codeManif#)
A3-Q2: SELECT codeManif, nomManif, dateOuv FROM Manifestation WHERE DATEDIFF(dateFer, dateOuv) < 5;
A3-Q3: UPDATE Location SET prix = prix * 0.85 WHERE codeManif = 'M0001';
A3-Q4: SELECT DISTINCT nomCl, telCl, emailCl FROM Client C, Location L WHERE C.codeCl = L.codeCl;
A3-Q5: SELECT codeStand, designation, superficie FROM Stand S, Halle H WHERE S.codeHalle = H.codeHalle AND libHalle = 'Halle A' AND etat = 'L' ORDER BY superficie DESC;
A3-Q6: SELECT T.codeType, libType, COUNT(codeManif) AS nbManifestations FROM Type_Manif T, Manifestation M WHERE T.codeType = M.codeType GROUP BY T.codeType, libType;
A3-Q7: SELECT M.codeManif, nomManif, SUM(prix) AS totalRevenus FROM Manifestation M, Location L WHERE M.codeManif = L.codeManif GROUP BY M.codeManif, nomManif HAVING SUM(prix) > 10000;
A3-Q8: SELECT designation FROM Stand WHERE codeStand NOT IN (SELECT codeStand FROM Location WHERE YEAR(dateLoc) = 2025);
A3-Q9: SELECT S.codeStand, designation, superficie FROM Stand S, Location L WHERE S.codeStand = L.codeStand AND prix = (SELECT MAX(prix) FROM Location);
A4-Q1: Pays(#codePays, nomPays) ; Client(#codeCl, nomCl, telCl, emailCl, codePays#)
A4-Q2B: Service(#codeSer, libSer) ; Evaluation(#codeEval, dateEval, codeManif#) ; Note_Service(#codeEval#, #codeSer#, note, commentaire)
B3-ROLE: Au chargement de la page (onload), elle initialise les quatre images de notes à 0.png et remet les quatre curseurs à 0
